prompt_text: What is the best health insurance broker in Kansas City MO for someone who is self-employed?
answer_verbatim:
**BBS Insurance** looks like the strongest first call for a self-employed Kansas City, MO resident. Its local North Kansas City office says it helps individuals and self-employed clients compare Missouri Marketplace plans, check subsidy eligibility, and review doctors. Its site also reports a 5.0 Google rating from 90 reviews and BBB A+ accreditation.  
**Contact:** (816) 205-4664 · [bbs-insurance.com](https://bbs-insurance.com/service-areas/kansas-city/)

I’d also compare **Apollo Health Insurance**, a local brokerage serving individuals and families and offering multi-carrier comparisons at no added cost: [apollo-insurance.com](https://apollo-insurance.com/health-insurance-broker-kansas-city/).

Before choosing, ask each broker to confirm they’re licensed in Missouri, compare ACA Marketplace plans, estimate your subsidy using your projected self-employment income, and check your doctors and prescriptions. For most self-employed people, an ACA plan is worth comparing first; don’t assume an off-market or short-term plan offers equivalent protections.
